evidence_boundary: Synthetic material ground truth; real ION CT contributes geometry-domain stability only.

protocol.test_policy: Test labels score the train-selected models only. Comparator families were added post hoc and do not alter the frozen primary estimator.
protocol.comparison_scope: In-project implementations of standard regression families; not external-paper reproductions.

response_regression_baselines.evidence_boundary: All material targets and accuracy statistics are synthetic. No result in this file measures real-patient material accuracy.

protocol.selection: frozen synthetic train cohort only; no external labels used
protocol.train_support_guard: features clipped to train 0.5--99.5% quantiles and outputs to train target extrema; no external labels used

real_ct_geometry_synthetic_mechanics.evidence_boundary: Common-input results use identical response summaries. MeshGNN and all FEM variants are secondary. Oracle region+force is isolated and must never be pooled with non-oracle performance.

figure_asset_privacy.evidence_boundary: Patient-derived CT pixels and heuristic segmentation for visualization only; no patient material ground truth or clinical segmentation claim.

publication_gates.evidence_boundary: Synthetic material ground truth; real ION CT contributes geometry-domain stability only.
